changelog:
- Initial release of text-to-svg.
- Converts natural language descriptions into SVG vector graphic code.
- Supports multiple styles: flat monochrome, gradient, stroke, minimal, tech/cyber, and 3D skeuomorphic.
- Provides style directives and sample palettes for branding, icons, and illustrations.
- Output is valid, standalone SVG markup following strict formatting guidelines.
display_name: Natural Language to SVG Vector Graphic Code
